gen-gf-autour-one-gf-domine: Round, loud and unbothered: Autour One draws its curves without any pressure swell at the turn. Domine goes the other way and keeps a quiet stroke modulation, with compact ascenders and a serif frame that feels dignified.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-esteban: Bold and expressive, Autour One reads like bent wire. Esteban, a serif with soft contrast in every curve and an oversized lowercase, feels warmer and more settled beside those tubular letters.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-faustina: Authoritative is the mood Faustina brings, with bowls that thin gently and a jaw-like c. Its mellow modulation is the pair's strongest quality, since Autour One above it keeps every stem and connecting stroke identical.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-halant: Heavy marker-tip lines from Autour One look traced in one pass, and every curve gets a clear channel into it. Halant, a serif with towering lowercase and slightly heavier stems than crossbars, adds the traditional grain.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-headland-one: Autour One bends each letter from a single length of wire, which gives the heading a bold, expressive outline. Headland One handles the text, a serif with medium contrast, generous gaps and a rounded o.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Hedvig Letters Serif carries a tall, sturdy lowercase with curves left open, a classic serif voice. Its thin strokes barely lighter than thick ones are the pair's strongest quality against the dowel-like stems of Autour One.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified is the feel of Marcellus SC, with gentle modulation and terminals pulled well back. Autour One keeps its line width through every turn above it, so the serif's soft heavier accents read as the quieter voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-montagu-slab: Chunky wire-like curves, all bold and a bit playful. Montagu Slab, a classic serif with a tempered thick-thin shift and no razor hairlines, takes over below, while Autour One earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Noto Serif Hentaigana opens every curved stroke and lets its small letters rise almost to cap height, with light modulation. Autour One sits above it with one stroke thickness everywhere, a bolder voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-ovo: Classic in mood, Ovo has a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and spacious curve terminals. Autour One is best at bold wirelike headings of one thickness, and Ovo is best at a text serif with a crayon-like thick-thin rhythm.
